[[Healer Silja]] is a collector, a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for weapons.

==Locations==
*[[Echovald Forest]]
**{{NPC location|Vasburg Armory}}

==Dialogue==
:''"[[Count zu Heltzer]] has ordered us to join in the fight against [[Shiro]], no matter our profession. I've been charged with developing a medicine to aid the suffering in [[Kaineng City]]. Some forest plants possess extremely potent properties that can be used to cure diseases. I believe that [[Dragon Root|dragon root]] might be useful in curing or at least lessening the pain associated with this plague, but I haven't the time to gather more of it. You would be doing our people, and those affected by this horrible sickness, a great service if you would bring me 5 Dragon Roots. In return, I can offer you this:"''
